verdict.rationale: Dialpad ships its own AI voice and digital agents, so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence describes 'connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents', which reads as Dialpad exposing itself to external AI clients (server role). Nothing documents Dialpad registering or calling third-party MCP servers' tools, so that evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.
